## [On which TV channel is Super Bowl 60 broadcast?](https://www.marca.com/en/nfl/super-bowl/2026/01/08/695f8dd4e2704e773a8b4591.html)
Super Bowl 60 **will be televised by NBC, which owns the official rights to the event** . In local markets, the game will be available through the network's affiliates.
NBC will have its renowned **Sunday Night Football** team, led by **Mike Tirico** on play-by-play, **Cris Collinsworth** as analyst and **Melissa Stark** reporting from the sideline.
In addition, the match will also be broadcast on **Telemundo,** offering Spanish-language coverage for the Latino audience in the United States.
